relations.subject: Charles Warre Malet
relations.role: resident in Cambay, then at Peshwa’s court in Pune, finally acting Governor of Bombay
relations.evidence: Joined the E.I.C. at early age and served as resident in Cambay (the Mughal emperor’s residence) in 1774-85 and then at Peshwa’s court in Pune. Finally acting Governor of Bombay.

relations.subject: George G. Malet
